issuer: the transit authorities (organismos de tránsito) of the municipalities of Putumayo
note: Read 2026-10-30. The National Land Transit Code (Ley 769 de 2002 as amended, the Senate's updated text, last updated 15 October 2026) sets the age and the term for the whole country: a licence for private vehicles from 16 (Art. 19, as Ley 2251 de 2022 wrote it), valid for ten years under 60 (Art. 22, as Decreto 19 de 2012 wrote it). Licences are issued by the local transit authorities, which set their own fees with the RUNT's; Putumayo Department's weren't read, so the fee is null. The identity card (cédula) is the ids engine's.

sources.title: Ley 769 de 2002, Código Nacional de Tránsito Terrestre, Secretaría General del Senado
sources.said: Para vehículos particulares: a) Saber leer y escribir. b) Tener dieciséis (16) años cumplidos. ... Las licencias de conducción para vehículos de servicio particular tendrán una vigencia de diez (10) años para conductores menores de sesenta (60) años de edad
